The workbook generation failed because expected data cells in the 'Task' sheet were empty (None), causing multiple matrix assertion failures.
The verifier failed with AssertionError in test_lookup_blocks and test_derived_values_and_stats. Specifically, cells H12:L17 (top block) and H35:L40 (net metric) returned None instead of the expected numerical values. Command 'pytest /tests/test_outputs.py' reported 2 failed and 4 passed tests. Ensure the logic populates the 'Task' worksheet at the specific coordinate ranges defined in the test suite's EXPECTED_TOP and EXPECTED_NET maps.
